text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear topic sentence and repeated \"However/For example/This shows\" structure","quality":"organization","description":"Essay B uses a more recognizable paragraph structure with transitions that make its ideas easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"Curfews interfere with young people's lives because they have to stay at work very late, have to intended to something, and have fun with their friends\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Essay B shows better control of sentence boundaries and clause structure, even though it still has errors."},{"evidence":"\"A lot of young people have things to do when they're out\"","quality":"clarity","description":"Essay B states its reasons more directly and with less repeated rephrasing, so the main points are easier to understand."},{"evidence":"\"When the teenager comes home on time, their mother wouldn't be scared\"","quality":"grammar control","description":"Essay B has fewer severe subject-verb and agreement problems than Essay A, which makes its grammar more stable overall."},{"evidence":"\"For example, when the teenagers are in a play... when they're at a school dance\"","quality":"development","description":"Essay B develops its reasons with clearer examples that stay closer to the point."}]}
